Cat Name Generator

Purr-fect cat names — mischievous troublemakers, regal royals, or delicious food-inspired names for your feline.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick mischievous, regal, or food style.
  2. Choose how many names to generate.
  3. Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What name styles are there?

Mischievous (like Bandit), regal (like Duchess), and food names (like Mochi) — each with its own bank.

Will I get duplicates?

Yes — every name is generated fresh from themed banks and results are deduplicated automatically.

How do I copy a name?

Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
